aboutPage.heading: About Lumis
aboutPage.p1: Lumis was born from a simple idea: reading shouldn't feel like opening a file. When you start a book on your computer, your phone, or anywhere else, it should feel like opening a real book — that feeling of a page turning, of finding exactly where you left off, of having your own library at hand instead of a folder full of loose PDFs.
aboutPage.p2: That's why Lumis combines two things that usually live apart: a universal reader that understands PDF, EPUB, MOBI, CBR, CBZ and TXT alike — with the same page-turn effect across every format, highlights, margin notes, and the exact bookmark where you left off — and a visual shelf you can build and decorate as if it were a real corner of your home. You choose the furniture, the background wall, where each book goes, which little plant or light you put next to it. It's not a list. It's your space.
aboutPage.p3: The name comes from “lumen”, the unit of light. We liked it because reading has always been, in some way, about finding light: the bedside lamp at night, the screen glow when you can't stop for just one more chapter, the light coming through the window onto your favorite armchair. Lumis wants to be that small, personal light that makes coming back to your library a pleasure, not a chore.
aboutPage.p4: This project is made for people who love building their reading space as much as reading itself — for those with a shelf saved “for someday” on Pinterest, for those who scribble quotes in the margins, for those who believe a well-kept book is also a form of care. If that's you, Lumis is your corner.

privacyPage.heading: Privacy Policy
privacyPage.intro: This Privacy Policy describes how Lumis collects, uses, stores and protects your personal data, in compliance with Argentina's Personal Data Protection Law No. 25,326 and its supplementary regulations.

s1.title: 1. Data controller
s1.bodyBeforeEmail: The party responsible for processing personal data collected through Lumis can be contacted at

s2.title: 2. Data we collect
s2.intro: We collect the following personal data when you use Lumis:

account.label: Account data:
account.desc: email address, display name, and password (stored encrypted, never in plain text).

files.label: Uploaded files:
files.desc: the digital books you upload to the Platform (PDF, EPUB, MOBI, CBR, CBZ, TXT) and their associated metadata (title, author, cover).

usage.label: Usage data:
usage.desc: reading progress, highlights, notes, reviews, and your shelf configuration.

prefs.label: Preferences:
prefs.desc: your theme preference (light/dark/system) and reading mode.

technical.label: Technical data:
technical.desc: session cookies strictly necessary to keep you identified (authentication) and to remember your theme preference.

s3.title: 3. Purpose of processing
s3.intro: We use your data exclusively to:

items.account: Create and manage your account and let you log in securely.
items.store: Store and show you your books, shelves, reading progress, highlights and notes.
items.prefs: Remember your customization preferences (theme, reading mode).
items.improve: Improve and maintain the Service's operation.
items.contact: Communicate with you regarding questions or issues you raise with us.

s4.title: 4. No sale or transfer of data to third parties
s4.body: Lumis does not sell, rent or trade your personal data or the content of your files to third parties. Your data is only shared with infrastructure providers strictly necessary to operate the Service (e.g., cloud storage and databases), who act as data processors under Lumis's instructions and with appropriate confidentiality and security guarantees.

s5.title: 5. Cookies
s5.body: We use technical cookies strictly necessary for the Service to function: a session cookie to keep you logged in, and a cookie to remember your light/dark theme preference. We do not use advertising or third-party tracking cookies.

s6.title: 6. Data security
s6.body: We adopt reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect your personal data against unauthorized access, loss or alteration, including private file storage, encrypted passwords, and encrypted communication (HTTPS).

s7.title: 7. Data subject rights (Access, Rectification, Cancellation, Opposition)
s7.intro: Under Law No. 25,326, you have the right to:

access.label: Access:
access.desc: request information about what personal data of yours we process.

rectification.label: Rectification:
rectification.desc: request correction of inaccurate or outdated data.

cancellation.label: Cancellation/Deletion:
cancellation.desc: request deletion of your data and account, including any files you've uploaded.

opposition.label: Opposition:
opposition.desc: object to the processing of your data in the cases provided for by law.

s7.exerciseBeforeEmail: You can exercise these rights at any time by writing to us at
s7.exerciseAfterEmail: . The Agency for Access to Public Information, as the Control Body for Law No. 25,326, is empowered to address complaints and claims filed regarding non-compliance with personal data protection regulations.

s8.title: 8. Data retention
s8.body: We retain your personal data for as long as you keep your account active. If you request account deletion, your data and files will be removed from our systems within a reasonable period, unless there is a legal obligation to retain them longer.

s9.title: 9. Minors
s9.body: Lumis is not directed at children under 13. If we become aware that we have collected data from a minor without appropriate consent, we will take the necessary steps to delete it.

s10.title: 10. Changes to this policy
s10.body: We may update this Privacy Policy periodically. Significant changes will be communicated through the Platform.

s11.title: 11. Contact
s11.bodyBeforeEmail: For questions about this Privacy Policy or to exercise your rights, write to us at
